final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): compact face, short length, wide width; soft rounded jaw; open rounded eyes, medium size, level outer corners, close-set; fine soft arches; straight slender bridge nose; small mouth.
comparison_observation: Rowlet has compact round cheeks, open eyes and small curved mouth; Dartrix has a longer oval face, low eyelids and thin lips. Petilil has narrower tapered lower face, Lilligant a longer face and more uplifted eyes, Whimsicott a broader smile. Compared actual light images and face crops.
original_policy: Only source hashes, exact prompts/UI, QA and final WebP are committed; PNG remains in this session.
